function.name: criminal_case_details_get
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific criminal case. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_number.description: The official number of the case in the judiciary system.

court_id.description: The ID of the court where the case was held.

include_hearing_details.description: Flag indicating if hearing details should also be retrieved. Default: False

message.content: 請問您是想了解哪一個國家的 2020 年總統大選結果呢？（例如美國、台灣等）
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2020年總統大選由誰獲勝？" That means "Who won the 2020 presidential election?" They likely refer to US Presidential Election 2020. The answer: Joe Biden. But we need to check if there's any nuance: maybe they want the winner of Taiwan's 2020 presidential election? In Taiwan, the 2020 presidential election was won by Tsai Ing-wen (Democratic Progressive Party). So which one? The question is ambiguous. The user wrote in Chinese: "2020年總統大選由誰獲勝？" Could refer to Taiwan or US. Usually, if no country specified, default might be Taiwan because it's Chinese context. But could be US. We need to ask clarifying question. According to policy, we can ask clarifying question. So we should ask: "您指的是哪個國家的總統大選？" Then proceed.
